title: Kalibrieren Libre 2, patched App, xdrip >= 20
symptom: The user reports that calibration of Libre 2 in xDrip is no longer possible for deviations >= 20 mg/dl. They give an example where xDrip shows 89 mg/dl while blood glucose is 142 mg/dl, causing false alarms.
cause: The thread explains that this behavior is intentional since the Libre 2 integration because the Libre bottoms out at 40 mg/dl, and calibrating at a high offset could prevent hypo alarms.
evidence_quote: This never had been possible. The reason behind it is that the Libre bottoms out at 40mg/dl. If the value goes deeper, it would still show 40mg/dl. So if you would calibrate it at +45mg/dl e.g. the lowest value it would be able to show is 85mg/dl Then the user could go hypo - and xDrip would not alarm as it would still have 85mg/dl
